shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index dropped 185 points or 0.36 percent on Tuesday to close at 51864 points.Losses were led by Cisco Systems (-4.50%), JPMorgan (-3.35%) and American Express (-2.62%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Amgen (4.33%), Home Depot (2.74%) and Honeywell International (2.58%).

children: The Dow Jones Index dropped 185 points or 0.36 percent on Tuesday to close at 51864 points.
Losses were led by Cisco Systems (-4.50%), JPMorgan (-3.35%) and American Express (-2.62%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Amgen (4.33%), Home Depot (2.74%) and Honeywell International (2.58%).

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.36% Lower
